eligibility.visualAdaptation: Use the same approved helper/button positions and styling; derive text and state for all intents and allow accessible wrapping without a visual redesign

navigation.subsequentEntry: Actual Signal → retained in-memory Places category
navigation.browseBack: Actual Signal with onboarding draft intact
navigation.categoryTabs: Filter fixed catalog; selected-tab tap no-op
navigation.viewPlace: Corresponding venue detail; one accessible action even when whole ticket is tappable

decoration.fillMode: FIT, preserve each crop aspect ratio
decoration.nativeUi: Ticket surfaces, names, modes, host/schedule/rule text, tabs, icons and controls remain native

prototypeBoundary.checkIn: Explanatory content only; no operational steps or success/bypass path
prototypeBoundary.memory: Onboarding draft and category retained only for active prototype session
prototypeBoundary.consent: No action grants approach/message consent. Later visibility requires a valid venue session; later chat requires deliberate Wave and acceptance.

browseToDetail.nativeBehavior: Bounded 2D ticket expansion; preserve art/native-content registration

motion.reduceMotion: Instant change or simple crossfade without expansion
motion.interaction: Immediate state changes; interrupt/reconcile decoration without delaying controls
motion.limitations: Raster scene and native ticket; no physical 3D unfolding, rig, ticket-to-Room transition or device frame-rate claim

a11yIntent.dynamicCopy: Wrap/grow mismatch helpers and longer labels; preserve contrast and reachability
a11yIntent.largerText: Adapt scrollable content and safe-area controls without clipping or shrinking readable text

measuredExport.source: Read from approved Figma frames without mutating them
